stage: Original Soundpipe 44.1 kHz ports, 24-bit sine oscillator with table interpolation, type 0 equal-power pan. Firmware computes endpoint sines in binary32. CRUSH precedes this stage and final width follows it.

controls.depth: Panel 0 recalls the historical dual-unity bypass. Positions 1..127 span the original depth 0..1. The enabled neutral center has original gain 1/sqrt(2) on each channel. Entering and leaving the original gain law takes 64 frames.
controls.rate: Free rate, 1/1920..10 Hz, exact INIT 0.25 Hz, independent for each owner. The original parameter ports each have a 0.1-second half-time.

coverage: real operator page and filesystem project save, two engine replacements and reload
legacy count 2, 3 and 4 and stock width/CRUSH regression

factory_stage.fixture: All original factory load commands in their recorded order. The original S1Rate helper resolves tempo-synced rates. A common one-second firmware note supplies pre-pan mono. Stage outputs are compared to the original Soundpipe modules with no alignment or level fit. First 63 transition samples additionally use the legacy wet ramp.
factory_stage.scope: The full-precision comparison injects the original pan control pair into the shipping DSP. The nearest-panel comparison uses both ordinary setters. Neither comparison loads the complete factory patch or includes the other original effects.

hardware_timing: No fresh on-device or strict target timing was collected for these images.
